description: This file contains interface definitions and extension methods related to stream lifecycle management in Orleans grains, including consumers and producers, along with helper extension methods.

classes.name: StreamLifecycleConsumerGrainExtensions
classes.description: Contains extension methods to simplify creation and management of stream consumers and producers.

methods.name: BecomeConsumer
methods.description: Extension method to make a grain become a consumer for a specified stream identified by Guid, namespace, and provider name.

methods.name: TestBecomeConsumerSlim
methods.description: Extension method to perform a slim version of becoming a consumer with specified stream parameters.

methods.name: RemoveConsumer
methods.description: Extension method to remove a consumer from a specific stream given its identifier and handle.

methods.name: BecomeConsumer
methods.description: Extension method for filtered consumers to become a consumer with additional sendEvensOnly parameter.

methods.name: SubscribeWithBadFunc
methods.description: Extension method for filtered consumers to subscribe with a potentially invalid function.

methods.name: BecomeProducer
methods.description: Extension method to make a grain become a producer for a specified stream.
